articles.expand: Tiff Macklem announced that he will retire after his seven-year term ends in June 2027. He should have left much sooner. It continues to baffle me that no central banker paid the price for the disastrous covid inflation. In no other high-profile field in the world is incompetence tolerated to the extent it is in central banking. It's a field that's protected both by government independence and a culture that accepts failure. No one exemplified that more than Tiff Macklem and his performance during the pandemic. But it supports the yen and adds upward pressure on front-end JGB yields, especially with USD/JPY near 160.
